en.headline: Three hikers fall ill on trails as temperatures hit 33C
en.dek: Two men suffered suspected heatstroke on the Po Pin Chau route in Sai Kung and a third developed dizziness; a government helicopter airlifted one patient to hospital.
body: At least three hikers fell ill on countryside trails on Sunday as temperatures in parts of Hong Kong reached 33 degrees Celsius under the Very Hot Weather Warning.

A 25-year-old visitor was suspected of suffering heatstroke while hiking with friends on the High Island Reservoir East Dam to Po Pin Chau route in Sai Kung around noon. A Government Flying Service helicopter airlifted him to Ruttonjee Hospital in Wan Chai for treatment.

Police received a first alert at about 12.09pm from Civil Aid Service personnel who found a male hiker in distress. A second call at 1.27pm reported another male hiker near the Po Pin Chau viewing point also showing signs of heatstroke; he remained conscious and was assisted by rescue crews with further helicopter support.

The Hong Kong Observatory had issued the Very Hot Weather Warning at 6.45am, forecasting a fine, dry and very hot day. Officials reminded the public, especially older people, pregnant women, young children and those with chronic conditions, to watch for heatstroke symptoms, drink more water and avoid over-exertion outdoors.

zh.headline: 氣溫高見33度 三名行山人士不適 破邊洲兩男疑中暑
zh.dek: 西貢破邊洲上午至中午接連兩宗疑中暑個案，其中一人由飛行服務隊直升機送院；另有一名行山人士感暈眩。
body: 周日本港部分地區氣溫升至攝氏33度，酷熱天氣警告生效期間，至少三名行山人士在郊外步道感到不適。
一名25歲訪客中午時分與友人在西貢萬宜水庫東壩至破邊洲路線行山時懷疑中暑，政府飛行服務隊直升機將他送往灣仔律敦治醫院治理。
警方約中午12時09分接獲民眾安全服務隊人員報告，發現一名男行山人士不適；下午1時27分再接獲另一名男行山人士在破邊洲觀景點附近疑中暑的報告，事主保持清醒，救援人員在飛行服務隊協助下處理。
天文台今早6時45分發出酷熱天氣警告，預料大致天晴、乾燥及酷熱。當局提醒市民，尤其長者、孕婦、幼兒及長期病患者，留意中暑徵狀、多喝水，並避免在戶外過度體力消耗。
